notes.title: Species: Unknown coming Spring 2025
notes.content:
[h2]We're thrilled to announce our next horror game, [i]Species: Unknown[/i]. The game is a gripping first-person shooter that dives you into a survival co-op experience like no other. The game will be available Spring 2025 on Steam.[/h2]

Sent on a mission aboard a devastated spaceship, you must identify and annihilate a terrifying threat through strategic collaboration with your teammates and the tools at your disposal.


[previewyoutube=jfEi1Q1AwPo;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037108/5d45a60794e9bb291e5a3ea19cbbf7a61b9d14ac.png[/img]

[b]TEAM UP[/b]
Collaborate with your teammates on different missions with varying difficulty levels, and objectives that can change depending on the map and the creature.

[b]TRACK[/b]
Examine the evidence found on the ship to identify the creature you're facing and figure out how to eliminate it. Solve puzzles and find the weapon that will help you during the boss fight.

[b]SURVIVE[/b]
Survive at all costs. Use the environment to your advantage and make use of tools like the motion detector, shield, or mini-map to navigate the ship without getting killed. Adopt the right group strategy to eradicate or capture the creatures.
[b]
REPEAT[/b]
Expand your list of kills and earn credits that you can use to customize your equipment, allowing you to face the fiercest creatures.


Join our [url=https://discord.gg/kVq4sXS]Discord[/url] to learn more about the game.
Add [i]Species: Unknown [/i]to your wishlist now and be among the first to embark on this spine-chilling journey

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747330/Species_Unknown/

notes.title: Vestiges: Fallen Tribes Pre-Alpha Available !
notes.content:
[h3]Our next game [i]Vestiges: Fallen Tribes[/i] has its pre-alpha build ! It is time you guys discover the Citizens of Illustra and the Adrariis, the two starting decks of the game. PC and PCVR crossplay is already available in the demo so be sure to share the news with all your friends.[/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2511780/Vestiges_Fallen_Tribes/


[i]Vestiges: Fallen Tribes[/i] is a collectible card game mixed with an autobattler, compatible with PC and VR, and set in a tribal science-fiction universe. Build the deck representing your clan, manipulate your figurines and place them on the game board. Soldiers automatically fight until one of the armies is decimated. Use strategy to defeat your opponents!


[url=https://forms.gle/rcEeQoVDLG54Bv1BA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/c6626de8286c9a3bbc398789bbf4327f3348a412.gif[/img][/url]


We're very excited for you guys to try our new game ! 
Don't hesitate to whishlist the game and share your feedback with us !

[list][*] [url=https://forms.gle/rcEeQoVDLG54Bv1BA]the feedback form [/url], the most efficient
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/kVq4sXS]the discord[/url], the most detailed
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/Vestiges_game] X[/url], also a possibility 
[/list]

Thank you for your time, your feedback and your support !

notes.title: The Propagation Collection is available now !
notes.content:
[h3]The [b]Propagation Collection[/b] bundle is available now. Enjoy the single-player adventure [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824960/Propagation_Paradise_Hotel/][i][b]Propagation: Paradise Hotel [/b][/i][/url] and the multiplayer wave shooter [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487770/Propagation_VR__Coop/] Co-op DLC[/url][/b][/i] with a special discount for the occasion ! [/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33550/Propagation_Collection/


This might be the perfect opportunity for those of you who were waiting for a co-op mode in [i][b]Propagation: Paradise Hotel[/b][/i] and a deeper storyline in [i][b]Propagation VR[/b][/i]. With this bundle you get the best of both worlds.


[list][*][b][i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824960/Propagation_Paradise_Hotel/]Propagation: Paradise Hotel[/url][/i][/b]: Trapped inside the Paradise Hotel, you are desperate to find your sister. Explore dark surroundings, gather resources, and survive terrifying encounters. This intense single-player VR survival horror game with great storytelling will get your adrenaline pumping.

[*][i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1363430/Propagation_VR/]Propagation VR[/url][/b][/i][i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487770/Propagation_VR__Coop/] Co-op DLC[/url][/b][/i]: Armed only with your guns and your fists, fight off terrifying zombies and other multi-species mutants in the static wave shooter, Propagation VR. Enjoy the experience in cooperation with a friend (or a friendly stranger)! The bad news is that you are both stuck in an abandoned subway station, fighting your way to survival. The good news is, at least someone will hear you scream...[/list]

Both games are now compatible with the following [b]bHaptics [/b]equipment: TactSuit X40 and X16 (vests), Tactal (face), and Tactosy for Arms. These make the games even more immersive, with haptic feedback for gunshots, enemy attacks, zombie bites, and much more. The game supports the equipment natively, so no external mod is needed.

We definitely hope you guys have an awesome time playing [i][b]Propagation: Paradise Hotel[/b][/i]. We are excited to get your feedbacks and impressions about the game so don’t hesitate to contact us on [url=https://discord.gg/kVq4sXS][u]Discord[/u][/url], or through our socials:

notes.title: Patch 1.1.5
notes.content:
## General updates
- Nerf door noise alerting enemies
- Nerf resurrection time for strong enemies
- Cap max resurrection number according to difficulty
- Inventory opens on the last visited page

## Balancing
- Ease zombie punching (extended body hitbox)
- Can kill zombies with punches (Easy only)
- Body shots deal more damage to enemies (Easy only)
- Prevent resource-related soft lock in final boss fight

## Bug fixes
- Fix minor map discovering issues (Pool & Gym)
- Account for death in game time
- Fix continuous rotation pivot issue

notes.title: Play Propagation: Paradise Hotel now !
notes.content:
We are very happy to finally announce that you play [b][i]Propagation: Paradise Hotel[/i][/b] now ! Be sure to get extra batteries for your flashlight cause you’re going to be exploring very dark surroundings… 

[previewyoutube=22XDEbLOa_E;full][/previewyoutube]

It took 2 years to develop [b][i]Propagation: Paradise Hotel[/i][/b], and we are pretty proud of the result. Although it was also made for standalone VR headsets, the Steam version is upscaled to meet PCVRs’ performances. 

Here is a short list of details that you Steam users and only you will be able to enjoy:
[list]
[*]Bullet holes on zombies when shot
[*]More details on floors and walls (blood, dirt, humidity…)
[*]Better effects when walking or shooting in the swimming pool
[*]Rain in lobby
[*]Dynamic shadows when lit by flashlight
[*]High definition textures
[*]Better reflection in materials
[*]Better rendering of skin
[*]Some dynamic blinking lights[/list]

We definitely hope you guys have an awesome time playing [i][b]Propagation: Paradise Hotel[/b][/i]. We are excited to get your feedbacks and impressions about the game so don’t hesitate to contact us on [url=https://discord.gg/kVq4sXS][u]Discord[/u][/url], or through our socials:

notes.title: Gun gameplay explained
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone! Until the launch of Propagation: Paradise Hotel, we want to show you the game more from "inside". [/h1]

[h3][b]In this first topic, we're going to focus on one of the most anticipated mechanics of this upcoming game: the Gun gameplay! [/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/1619118dff6815eb9d6b65ee3870649b74f412e9.gif[/img]

Our goal with Propagation: Paradise Hotel is to offer a scary experience while providing a simple, yet complete mechanic. As the Wii was at one time, VR allows us to offer an experience that is closer to reality and fun.

That's why making the reloading system more complex than in PropagationVR became a logical evolution, in order to move away from the Arcade style of the first opus and to get much closer to the oppressive atmosphere present in the survival horror game style.

[h3][b]This reloading mechanic is definitely the feature you asked us for the most! That's why we made it a point to take care of it and go in that direction.  [/b][/h3]

But we wanted to go further than that! The gun and its mechanics should be an integral part of the atmosphere of the game, making the feature more complex brings a strong tension in the fight scenes. So you'll have to overcome your fear and the stress of the situation to get through it! 

We relied a lot on the concepts of Shinji Mikami (game designer of the Resident Evil series) to make the basis of our gun gameplay. One of his key concepts is that [i]the player should have new stages of difficulty and horror as soon as he has mastered one[/i]. We definitely wanted the gun to be one of the steps to completing your adventure! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591057/4cc286bd7877eddfc36f2b21013ac997cd760136.png[/img] 

[h3][b]During our 1st gameplay teaser (find it here: [url=www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEkFKsEyoJM]www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEkFKsEyoJM[/url]) many of you told us that the "T-Cup" grip was not optimal and very little used in the handling of a firearm.[/b][/h3] 

So we put ourselves in the shoes of Emily, the main character of this adventure. And what would a civil with a gun do, if not repeat what he saw in a movie? 

So we decided to leave this grip for people who like her would do this instinctively. 

However, you may encounter people who are experts in handling weapons in Propagation: Paradise Hotel... But we'll save that for another topic which is available here :

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1363430/announcements/detail/3403058363948329057

[b]Thank you so much for your support!

If you want to know more about the universe of Propagation: Paradise Hotel and follow the development of the game, please wishlist it here : [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824960/Propagation_Paradise_Hotel/

You can also join our [url=https://discord.gg/kVq4sXS]Discord[/url] and our dedicated [url=https://twitter.com/PropagationVR]Propagation Twitter[/url] to chat with us! 

See you soon!
